title: Travel in China
intro: Getting around mainland China: greetings, help, transport, hotels, food, paying and emergencies.

scenes.title: Greetings and politeness basics
scenes.description: What a traveller says all day: hello to one person, to a group and politely; thank you and the replies; sorry vs excuse me (对不起 / 不好意思 / 打扰一下 / 请问); goodbye; short yes/no-type answers; declining an offer; plus the formulas shop and restaurant staff say to you.

rules.rule: The level-1 politeness core is 你好 / 谢谢 / 对不起 / 再见, with the replies 不客气 (to thanks) and 没关系 (to an apology). Learners are expected to recognise and exchange these in meeting, parting and everyday situations.
rules.why: The 2025 HSK task syllabus (in force 2026-07) lists exchanging exactly these as a level-1 communicative task; the HSK 3.0 level-1 sample tests the 对不起 → 没关系 and 谢谢 → 不客气 pairs.
